description: Land Acquisition - Hathale & Thawalanthenna, Panwila D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purposes, including their locations, boundaries, extents, and claimant information. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns land acquisitions and property matters.
